recent_exchanges.topic: Discussing Turkish Airlines' new routes across Farafina, comparing air travel to traditional caravan paths and river ferrying, noting how 'farafina' encompasses both the continent and its diverse peoples.
recent_exchanges.orchestrator_directive: Elicit Bambara terms for modern and traditional travel modes, route nomenclature, geographic orientation, and the semantic range of 'farafina' in civic and commercial discourse.

utterances.text_native: Turkish Airlines bɛ farafina kɔnɔn-kɔnɔnna, nka k'a kɛ lɔlɔ-yiri-yiri, o tɛ kɛ k'a fɛn kɛ k'a kɛ kɔnɔ-kɔnɔ-la k'a kɛ kɔnɔ-kɔnɔ-la.
utterances.gloss_en: Turkish Airlines is crossing all over Africa, but unlike the old caravan paths, it is much faster.
utterances.gloss_fr: Turkish Airlines traverse toute l'Afrique, mais contrairement aux anciens chemins de caravane, c'est beaucoup plus rapide.

utterances.text_native: Keyita y'a fɔ ko Turkish Airlines bɛ taama farafina kɔnɔ ka tɛmɛ jamana caman kan, nka o tɛ kɛ kabila sila kɔrɔlenw ni bajiraw ɲɛsɛgɔta ye; farafina bɛ duguɲa ni mɔgɔw bɛɛ dafalen.
utterances.gloss_en: Keita said that Turkish Airlines travels across Africa passing through many countries, but it is not like the old caravan paths and river ferries; farafina includes both the continent and all its peoples.
utterances.gloss_fr: Keita a dit que Turkish Airlines voyage à travers l'Afrique en passant par de nombreux pays, mais ce n'est pas comme les anciennes pistes caravanières et les bacs fluviaux ; farafina englobe à la fois le continent et tous ses peuples.

utterances.text_native: Awa, farafina kɔnɔn-kɔnɔnna bɛ kɛ saba-saba, nka k'a kɛ lɔlɔ-yiri-yiri, o tɛ kɛ k'a fɛn kɛ k'a kɛ kɔnɔ-kɔnɔ-la.
utterances.gloss_en: Yes, crossing Africa is now common, but this speed is unlike the old paths.
utterances.gloss_fr: Oui, traverser l'Afrique est devenu courant, mais cette rapidité diffère des anciens sentiers.

recent_exchanges.topic: Discussing the vitamin (witamini) content of millet and shea butter, while referencing the biblical figure Yuhana (John) in a proverb about health, and clarifying the terms yahutuw, lagi, kene heard in traveler tales.
recent_exchanges.orchestrator_directive: Elicit standardized \lx entries for witamini, yahutuw, lagi, kene, yuhana with grammatical categories and example sentences.

utterances.text_native: Awa, witamini bɛ sanu ni n-tigi na, nka Yuhana kuma bɛ kɛ kene sago na.
utterances.gloss_en: Yes, vitamins are in millet and shea butter, but John's words are for health.
utterances.gloss_fr: Oui, les vitamines sont dans le mil et le beurre de karité, mais les paroles de Jean sont pour la santé.

utterances.text_native: Sanu ni n-tigi kɔnɔ, lagi ni witamini bɛ yen; kene ka ɲi, yahutuw fɔlɔ bɛ o cogo na.
utterances.gloss_en: In millet and shea butter there is strength and vitamins; health is good, as the traveler tales say.
utterances.gloss_fr: Dans le mil et le beurre de karité, il y a la force et les vitamines ; la santé est bonne, comme le disent les contes des voyageurs.

utterances.text_native: Sanu ni n-tigi kɔnɔ, witamini ni lagi bɛ kɛ kɛnɛya ye, nka yahutuw bɛ fɔlɔ kɛ kɛnɛya kɔrɔ ye.
utterances.gloss_en: In millet and shea butter, vitamins and strength create health, but traveler tales tell of health's importance.
utterances.gloss_fr: Dans le mil et le beurre de karité, les vitamines et la force créent la santé, mais les contes de voyageurs parlent de l'importance de la santé.
